top_signals.title: Druckenmiller, Bessent’s Early Mentor, Calls Bond Buys a Mistake
top_signals.summary: Stanley Druckenmiller, the billionaire investor who mentored Scott Bessent in his early career as a hedge fund trader, called the Treasury secretary’s plan to spend billions buying back US bonds a mistake.
